subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Salient
solution:
The correct answer is **"Insignificant".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Salient **means ​'most important or noticeable (**सर्वाधिक महत्वपूर्ण या सबसे अधिक दिखाई पड़ने वाला**)**'.**

 
 
• ​Example: *The article presented the **salient **facts of the dispute clearly and concisely.*
 
 
 
• Marked option 'Insignificant' means ​'of little value or importance (**महत्वहीन, उपेक्षणीय, नगण्य, निरर्थक**)**'.**
 
 
• ​Example: *The rate has fallen by an **insignificant **amount.*
 
 
 
• The word 'Insignificant' best expresses the opposite meaning as the given word '**Salient**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Chief **means the person who has command or control over an organization (**संगठन का प्रमुख; प्रधान**).
 
• **Remarkable **means unusual and surprising in a way that people notice (**असाधारण और आश्‍चर्यजनक ध्‍यान देने योग्‍य**).
 
• **Eminent **means used about a person who is famous and important (**व्‍यक्ति जो प्रख्‍यात और महत्वपूर्ण हो; प्रतिष्ठित**).
